unit.why: A short anecdote, told by R. Yitzhak of Neskhiz, about R. Mordechai of Neskhiz at the court of R. Michel of Zlotchov, who gives charity to a simple man himself, followed by an appended homiletic excerpt from Noam Elimelech on charity.
unit.boundary_note: narrative ends at 'לעשותו בעצמו'; the rest is an appended teaching quoted from Noam Elimelech

stories.start_quote: סיפר מרן הה״ק ר׳ יצחק מנעסכיז שאביו
stories.summary_en: When an honourable man came for alms, R. Michel of Zlotchov had his disciple R. Mordechai of Neskhiz give it, but he gave to a simple man himself, explaining that charity effects a holy unification, which is harder to achieve when giving to a simple person.
